response:
All four issues are fixed in round 1 of 2. The proof command passes (23/23), the related suites pass (37 files, 278 tests), and typecheck is clean. Nothing is committed or pushed. The fix that brings back unanswered RC cross-outs after a reload has no player-level test yet, and no browser checks have been run.

**Something you should check:** `git status` now shows `supabase/functions/mcp/index.ts` as modified. I didn't edit it, and it's MCP code the work order puts off-limits, so it most likely came from another agent sharing this worktree. I left it untouched; please make sure it doesn't go into this integration.

## The four fixes
1. **Switching accounts.** The drill runner (`DrillContent`) now sits inside a new `DrillActorScope`, which remounts it whenever the signed-in user changes. That throws away the in-memory cross-outs, highlights and undo history. A new mounted test marks a question as account A, switches to account B, and checks that B sees no marks, no undo, and nothing saved under B, while A's saved record is unchanged.
2. **RC cross-outs on unanswered questions.** Cross-outs are now also saved on this device under a key scoped to the session and question (`rc:<sessionId>:<questionId>`). When the session reloads, they are put back only on questions that have no saved attempt and no cross-outs from an attempt. This never creates or submits an attempt. It is off in review, timed sittings, practice-test runs and protected review. A new test checks that the session scoping keeps these apart from other sessions and from the bookmark.
3. **Unreadable or newer-version stores.**
   - An unparseable or partly malformed store is copied untouched to a separate `…:unreadable` key before anything writes over it. A second unreadable copy never replaces the first. If that copy can't be made, nothing is written at all.
   - A store written by a newer version is never overwritten. New marks stay on the page only, and the control says so.
   - In every case the toolbar now shows a visible line explaining what happened, and the popover gives the full wording.
4. **Two tabs on one account.** Every change now reads the latest stored copy and changes only that one question before saving, so a second tab's marks survive. A storage event from another tab for the same account refreshes this one; events for other accounts are ignored. Tests cover a stale second tab and the storage-event refresh.

## Files changed this round
- **New:** `src/components/drill/DrillActorScope.tsx`
- **Modified:** `src/lib/questionStudyTools.ts`, `src/hooks/useQuestionStudyTools.ts`, `src/components/drill/official/StudyAidsControls.tsx`, `src/pages/Drill.tsx`, `src/features/rc/pages/RcPlayer.tsx`, `src/lib/questionStudyTools.test.ts`, `src/components/drill/official/StudyAids.integration.test.tsx`

Earlier changes to the toolbar, the question pane and `useQuestionHighlights` were not touched this round.

## Test and command results
- `npx vitest run src/lib/questionStudyTools.test.ts`: 1 file, 23 tests passed.
- `src/components/drill`, `src/hooks/useQuestionHighlights.test.ts` and `src/features/rc` together: 37 files, 278 tests passed, including the RC save-safety suite.
- `npm run typecheck`: no errors.
- ESLint on the new and changed library, hook and component files: clean.
- I didn't rerun the wider `src/pages` suite this round. Last round it had 2 `AcademyMainhub` failures, which fail even when run alone, and 1 `AssistantComposer` failure that passes when run alone. Neither file imports my files directly, but I haven't checked them against BASE.
- No tool calls were denied this round.

## Decisions for the reviewer
- **Restored RC cross-outs join the attempt.** Once restored, they become part of the session's working set, so they are saved with the attempt when the student answers. That matches how resuming a live drill already treats them.
- **Old RC session keys stay on the device.** Session-scoped cross-out entries aren't cleaned up after a session is submitted. That's harmless to correctness, but the store slowly grows.
- **Two tabs on the same question.** If both tabs change the same question, the last write for that question wins. Other questions are always merged.
- **Highlights on screen don't follow another tab.** In the LR drill, highlights on a question already open aren't redrawn from another tab's changes. Cross-outs on a question not yet touched in this run are.

## Still open
- A player-level test for RC cross-outs coming back after a reload.
- Browser checks: LR and RC walks at 390, 820, 1060, 1280 and 1600 wide, with the side pane open, keyboard only, and 200% text zoom.
- Codex's inspection.
- Ticket 179 stays open.
